recurring.title: Spese ricorrenti
recurring.hint: Cron standard a 5 campi (minuto ora giorno-del-mese mese giorno-della-settimana), UTC. Esempio
recurring.hint_example: = 09:00 il giorno 1 di ogni mese. Ad ogni esecuzione viene generata una nuova spesa dal modello scelto.
import.title: Importa da Splitwise
import.hint: Importa i tuoi amici e gruppi Splitwise. Le spese non vengono importate (come nell'app di riferimento). Crea una chiave API Splitwise nelle impostazioni del tuo account Splitwise e incollala qui sotto — viene usata una sola volta per questa richiesta e non viene memorizzata.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.no_archives: No archives yet. Create one, or set BACKUP_CRON for scheduled backups.
backup.secret_warning: An archive contains every table, including password hashes and session tokens. It is encrypted with a key derived from SESSION_SECRET, so rotating or losing that secret makes every existing archive permanently unrestorable.
backup.insecure_warning: BASE_URL is not https, so an archive downloaded here travels unencrypted over the network. Use HTTPS, or take backups with the command line instead.
backup.restore_warning: Restoring REPLACES ALL CURRENT DATA. Every table is emptied and refilled from the archive, and the upload directory is replaced. A backup of the current data is taken first.
backup.preview_title: This archive is valid and matches this database.
backup.restoring_body: The restore is running. Do not close this page or restart the server.
backup.cli_body: The same backup and restore is available without the browser, and works when the server is down.
backup.autorestore_on: AUTO_RESTORE_DIR is set: an archive placed there is restored on the next start, unless the marker file is present.
err.restore_no_file: Choose an archive file to upload.
err.restore_upload: The upload failed or exceeded the size limit.
err.restore_wrong_secret: This archive was created with a different SESSION_SECRET:
err.restore_schema: This archive does not match this version of GoSplit:
err.restore_confirm: The confirmation phrase did not match, so nothing was changed.
err.restore_expired: That restore is no longer pending. Upload the archive again.
